build: sudo chown -R opam:opam /src && sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends gcc libc6-dev && eval $(opam env) && opam install -y dream && ocaml gen_assets.ml > assets.ml && dune build --profile release ./main.exe && cp _build/default/main.exe server && chmod +w server && mkdir -p bundle/lib && cp server bundle/server && cp /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libssl.so.3 /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libcrypto.so.3 /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libev.so.4 bundle/lib/ && cp start.sh bundle/start.sh && chmod +x bundle/start.sh && tar -czf bundle.tar.gz -C bundle . && printf '#define BUNDLE_ID "ocaml-%s"\n#define BUNDLE_ENTRY "start.sh"\n' "$(sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | cut -c1-16)" > bundle_config.h && gcc -O2 -o app launcher.c bundle.S && ls -l app
